name: LV5 Death
doc: LV5 Death (Omega Weapon's and Tonberry King's enemy attack; LV?Death's library relocated, its director Death's; the act family, the Boko summons' kind): one emitter per target - a reaper appears in front of it, fading in in the dark with its aura's actor system and the stage wobbling, strikes - the dark actor system and dark spark bursts - and vanishes; the damage. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag345_lv5_death.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its state functions called from the phases, its parts spawned by it): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own - and the exe data words pointing into it (the engine's global index, the word)

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: The act family's master: once its children are gone, the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the reapers (the port's, their dark draw)
the auras' and the strikes' actor systems (the port's)
the stage wobble in and out (the port's)
run by the master, nothing spawned there

parts.title: Reaper
parts.doc: A reaper in front of each target: fading in in the dark, striking, vanishing; its sounds

parts.title: Actor systems
parts.doc: The aura's actor system at its appearance, the dark one at the strike (their actor data the exe's)

groups.label: Aura
groups.doc: Its actor system at the reaper's appearance: Ticks, Mode (2: the reaper data's fixed positions)

groups.label: Strike
groups.doc: The dark actor system at the strike: Ticks, Mode (0: the bones)

params.doc: Played when it appears (the first target)

params.label: Strike sound
params.doc: Played when its dark draw ends

params.doc: Its fade down by this a tick (4096: fully shown)

params.label: Dark until frame
params.doc: Drawn dark until this frame of its animation

params.label: Strike frame
params.doc: It strikes (the damage, the dark actor system, the sparks) at this frame

params.label: Fade out

params.doc: The TIM image it uploads as it is (a palette when the game's has one)

params.label: Spark sizes
params.doc: The dark sparks' scale x, y, z and fade (4096: 1) at each tick of their 15 (128 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)

params.label: Model 1524664
params.doc: The prim model at 0x1524664 (a mesh of 9 vertices, 8 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

tasks.doc: One per target (the engine's emitter, its states the port's): follows its target; places the reaper in front of it and starts the director; the damage once the reaper struck; then waits for the director's end, releases the master.
The director: every tick the reaper data's phase bookkeeping, then its states: the reaper's textures (the first target), after a tick the reaper creature, done.
